messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off staged rollout v4.0.0 -> 5% global (eu-west 5%, us-east 5%) in change window 03:00-04:00 UTC
elaine: noting initial p95 wobble in us-east (~80ms) but low sample; grabbing traces
harry: seeing a small cluster of incomplete KV cache warmups tied to new serialization path
sre-oncall: recommend holding us-east to 0% and pin to v3.9.8 while we investigate. keep eu-west at 5% for now
elaine: agreed, us-east shows increased tail errors with serialize_v2 enabled
infra-bot: suggested command: `redwoodctl rollout update --region us-east --traffic 0` and `redwoodctl rollout pin --region us-east --version v3.9.8 --reason \"serialize_v2 tail errors\"`
elaine: executing hold via deploy-bot now
```
redwoodctl rollout update --region us-east --traffic 0
redwoodctl rollout pin --region us-east --version v3.9.8 --reason "serialize_v2 tail errors"
```
deploy-bot: running: `redwoodctl rollout update --region us-east --traffic 0`
deploy-bot: us-east traffic set to 0% (op: tx-11011)
deploy-bot: running: `redwoodctl rollout pin --region us-east --version v3.9.8`
deploy-bot: pinned us-east -> v3.9.8 (pin id: pin-3109) :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: plan: pin + run canary smoke (inference + kv warmup + serialization checks). If smoke OK, keep pin and prepare 4.0.1 patch; if failing, prepare escalation playbook
harry: starting targeted smoke for serialization surface, ETA 6m
devex: heads-up: I'll add a short line to the release notes and support playbook: "US canary paused due to serialization tail errors"
elaine: also, noting autoscaler reacted to transient latency; scaling should be stable now but will monitor
infra-bot: recorded incident candidate: INC-cand-4422 with initial signals attached
harry: smoke failing on one node with old dep binary mismatch; suspect mixed image tags during rollout edge-case
sre-oncall: good catch. that would explain partial regressions. plan: keep region pinned, coordinate an image tag sweep and rebuild, avoid unpin until images aligned
elaine: pinging infra and release-engineering to validate image registry tags and promote new build
devex: drafting a customer-facing blurb: "Rolling update paused for US canary due to serialization mismatch; investigation ongoing." Will post to support once approved
sre-oncall: marking this as STOP for us-east. eu-west remains in OBSERVE at 5%. change window ends in ~25m
harry: filing ROLLBACK-TRACE-551 with repro, stack, and failing container id; assigning to image-team
elaine: once image sweep and new build ready, we'll run full canary (5% -> 10%) in non-pinned regions and keep previous region pinned until stable
deploy-bot: reminder: to resume pinned region run `redwoodctl rollout resume --region us-east` and to unpin use `redwoodctl rollout unpin --region us-east --pin-id pin-3109`
sre-oncall: thanks all. keeping watch on eu-west metrics and global SLOs.
